notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Walking Ballista.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 2.
